$comment: SkyyRose LLC interactive commerce feature scaffold from current web research.
commerce_contract_policy: All product, variation, media, availability, CTA, cart, checkout, order, service and retention features MUST consume the normalized v2 contract. A feature without an authoritative server response is UNVERIFIED and cannot be release-ready.

tiers.build_now: Core theme value with known platform contracts.
tiers.pilot: Requires founder, SOT, privacy, provider, or moderation approval.
tiers.future: Requires demonstrated value, budget, and production evidence.
tiers.reject: Conflicts with SkyyRose canon, accessibility, commerce truth, or performance.

proof_contract.principle: Proof is generated by the build system; it is not a late approval ritual.
required_evidence: commerce-truth result for product, price, inventory, and CTA state

artifact_contract.source: candidate-bound source IDs or an explicit UNKNOWN/BRAND_SPECIFIC decision
artifact_contract.interaction: automated trace with focus, input, success, error, and fallback states
artifact_contract.commerce: SKU, variation, availability, price, and event payload checks where applicable
artifact_contract.commerce_state: normalized payload and action response must validate against ../v2/commerce-state-contract.json
artifact_contract.release: independent visual QA, accessibility, performance, and security sign-off

proof_contract.ready_when: A feature cannot be release-ready until every required evidence class is attached to the same candidate snapshot.

features.name: Chapter transitions
features.user_value: Makes a collection feel like a place without blocking discovery.
features.implementation: CSS/IntersectionObserver fade and clip reveals; one active sequence per section.

features.name: High-density PDP media
features.user_value: Answers how it looks, fits, moves, and is made.
features.implementation: SOT-bound front/back/detail/movement sequence, zoom, poster-backed video.
features.fallback: First verified image plus alt text and specifications.
features.cta: Add to bag / Check size and fit

features.name: Sticky story/product split
features.user_value: Keeps visual evidence present while the customer reads or decides.
features.implementation: Sticky media on desktop; paired linear blocks on mobile.

features.name: Interactive size and fit guide
features.user_value: Raises fit confidence before purchase and reduces avoidable uncertainty.
features.implementation: Category selector, unit toggle, tables, garment measurements, model references, disclosed recommendation.
features.fallback: Accessible static tables and contact path.
features.cta: Find my size / Contact fit help

features.name: Shoppable editorial chapters
features.user_value: Connects an outfit or story to exact products.
features.implementation: Labeled hotspots on desktop; ordered product list on mobile.
features.fallback: Captioned image followed by product cards.

features.name: Stateful CTA microinteractions
features.user_value: Confirms actions without ambiguity.
features.implementation: Rose-gold primary, text-link secondary, explicit loading/success/error/unavailable states.
features.fallback: Native button state and live region announcement.
features.cta: Add to bag / Place order / Submit request

features.name: Visual search extension point
features.user_value: Lets customers start from a garment reference image.
features.implementation: Upload/URL input contract with catalog-only result response; provider adapter remains optional.

features.name: 360-degree verified product viewer
features.user_value: Recreates the ability to inspect an item from multiple angles.
features.implementation: 36–72 SOT frames, drag/touch rotation, lazy initialization, poster image.

features.name: AI style advisor
features.user_value: Turns an occasion, preference, or constraint into a guided catalog path.
features.implementation: Constrained retrieval over approved products, fit facts, availability, and disclosed rationale.
features.cta: Ask the style guide / See matching pieces

features.name: Own-photo virtual try-on
features.user_value: Helps customers visualize a garment on themselves.
features.implementation: Approved provider or model; consent, generated-label, deletion, and share controls.
features.fallback: Model reference gallery with worn size and measurements.

features.name: Member co-creation challenge
features.user_value: Turns membership into creative participation and community proof.
features.implementation: Constrained design controls, submission, moderation, voting, badge, and winner state.
features.cta: Create design / Vote now / Join members

features.name: Phygital QR chapter
features.user_value: Connects Oakland place and physical touchpoints to digital story.
features.implementation: Signed QR/deep link unlocks an approved chapter, badge, or appointment path.

features.name: Playable campaign mystery
features.user_value: Extends a collection world into optional discovery and recall.
features.implementation: Short clue sequence with skip-to-shop, progress, save/share, and accessible transcript.
features.cta: Enter the story / Skip to shop

features.name: WebGL collection world
features.user_value: Creates a memorable place for a campaign or collection.
features.implementation: Lazy WebGL scene with DOM commerce overlay, device budget, static poster, and mobile linear mode.

features.name: WebAR garment preview
features.user_value: Lets customers preview a garment in supported devices.
features.implementation: WebAR/provider adapter with device detection and clear fit limitations.
features.cta: View in AR / See fit guide

features.name: Voice shopping parity
features.user_value: Makes product discovery available through speech.
features.implementation: Speech input with visible text transcript and catalog-grounded results.

features.name: Price tracking
features.user_value: Lets customers wait for a price condition with consent.
features.implementation: Explicit threshold, size/variation, notification preference, and opt-out.

features.name: Agentic checkout adapter
features.user_value: Reduces friction after the customer has made a clear decision.
features.implementation: Provider adapter only after WooCommerce/payment/idempotency/fraud/support review.

features.name: Live shopping and replay
features.user_value: Adds expert demonstration with an asynchronous replay path.
features.implementation: Captioned live/video module with exact product links and replay chapters.

features.name: Optional sensory audio ritual
features.user_value: Adds atmosphere to an approved campaign world.
features.implementation: Explicit play control, caption/transcript parity, volume state, and no autoplay.
features.fallback: Visual chapter with text and stills.

features.name: Generic motion quarantine
features.user_value: Protects recognition, clarity, and speed.
features.implementation: Do not ship liquid glass, gradient text, cursor trails, scroll-jacking, fake scarcity, hover-only facts, or unverified 3D.
features.fallback: Static brand system and truthful commerce components.
acceptance: all critical paths usable without motion

features.name: Candidate-bound proof bundle
features.user_value: Makes the feature measurable and reviewable from its first build.
features.implementation: Generate source, render, interaction, accessibility, performance, and commerce-truth evidence against one candidate snapshot.
features.fallback: Manual review checklist with explicit UNKNOWN states.
